# The environment of panes and jobs (C3.13): `env | sort` in new panes, with -e, -E and
# update-environment, and in a job, compared with tmux's (the server's pid normalized).
size 200x50
normalize /s,[0-9]+, /s,PID,
# Each pane's program prints and ends; remain-on-exit keeps it to be captured.
run new-session -d -s keep 'exec cat'
run set -g remain-on-exit on ; set -g remain-on-exit-format ''
run set -g update-environment[20] 'TMUX_TMP*' ; set -ga update-environment ' NOT_IN_THE_CLIENT'
run new-session -d -s e -n w -e FROM_NEW=1 'env | sort'
wait -t e:w '#{pane_dead}' == 1
run capture-pane -p -J -S - -t e:w
run new-window -t e -n x -e FOO=bar -e 'SPACED=a b' 'env | sort'
wait -t e:x '#{pane_dead}' == 1
run capture-pane -p -J -S - -t e:x
run new-session -d -s noe -n w -E 'env | sort'
wait -t noe:w '#{pane_dead}' == 1
run capture-pane -p -J -S - -t noe:w
run set -g default-terminal xterm-256color ; split-window -t e:w 'echo $TERM $TMUX_PANE $SHELL $PWD'
wait -t e:w.1 '#{pane_dead}' == 1
run capture-pane -p -t e:w.1
run display -p -t e '#{FROM_NEW}|#{NOT_IN_THE_CLIENT}|#{TMUX_TMPDIR}'
run run-shell -t e 'env | sort | grep -v "^_="'
run kill-server
